ambiguities: The paper is conceptual and names no horizon; Weekly chosen so that the propositions compose with the library's engagement and burnout constructs.
Propositions 4-6 relate unit features to individual behaviors; the kernel has no top-down relation, so the pipeline states them over the library's unit-level aggregate of agentic behaviors.
P7 (development) has no construct in the library vocabulary and is omitted.
